policy.statement: Proofs in this repository may depend only on the three axioms of classical mathematics that Mathlib itself assumes. Any other axiom, and any axiom declared in this repository, requires a reviewed entry here. `sorryAx` may never be allowlisted: its presence in a dependency report means a proof was completed by `sorry` and reached the environment.
policy.evidence: Lean `#print axioms` output captured in the full-build log and checked on every CI run.

allowed_axioms.name: propext
allowed_axioms.rationale: Propositional extensionality. Assumed by Mathlib and by essentially all of its order, algebra and analysis development; every theorem in this repository inherits it through Mathlib.
allowed_axioms.reconsideration_trigger: Reconsider only if Mathlib itself removes the axiom, which would be a foundational change far outside this repository.

allowed_axioms.name: Classical.choice
allowed_axioms.rationale: The axiom of choice, in Lean's `Classical.choice` form. Required by classical logic as used throughout Mathlib, including decidability of real comparisons and the classical case analysis this repository's error bounds rely on.
allowed_axioms.reconsideration_trigger: Reconsider only if the development is rebuilt on constructive foundations.

allowed_axioms.name: Quot.sound
allowed_axioms.rationale: Soundness of quotient types. Assumed by Mathlib and reached through any use of quotient constructions, including the real numbers as used in every numerical-stability statement here.
allowed_axioms.reconsideration_trigger: Reconsider only if Mathlib's quotient foundation changes.

forbidden.name: sorryAx
forbidden.reason: A dependency on sorryAx means a proof completed by `sorry` reached the environment. It is rejected unconditionally and cannot be allowlisted.

forbidden.name: native_decide
forbidden.reason: Not an axiom but a trust extension: it discharges goals through compiled evaluation outside the kernel. No proof in this repository uses it, and introducing one would require a reviewed policy change rather than an allowlist entry.

measured.note: The 36 files are the reason strict comment and string handling is part of the contract: their documentation states that no placeholder is used, and a naive text search reports every one of them.
